description: g01 What is the refund window for annual plans?

vars.query: What is the refund window for annual plans?
vars.context:
[P-101] Annual plans are eligible for a full refund within 14 days of purchase.
[P-102] Monthly plans can be cancelled at any time; partial months are not refunded.

description: g02 Where are EU backups stored?

vars.query: Where are EU backups stored?
vars.context:
[S-12] EU tenant backups are stored in eu-central-1 (Frankfurt) with AES-256.
[S-13] Automated snapshots run every 6 hours.

description: g03 What is the webhook timeout?

vars.query: What is the webhook timeout?
vars.context:
[W-05] Endpoints must respond with a 2xx status within 5 seconds.
[W-03] Failed deliveries are retried 5 times with exponential backoff over 6 hours.

description: g04 What TLS versions are supported?

vars.query: What TLS versions are supported?
vars.context:
[S-03] All endpoints enforce TLS 1.2 or TLS 1.3.
[S-04] TLS 1.0 and 1.1 were disabled in 2023.

description: g05 How many webhook endpoints can I register?

vars.query: How many webhook endpoints can I register?
vars.context:
[W-01] Workspaces may register up to 10 active webhook endpoints.
[W-02] Each endpoint can subscribe to any number of event types.

description: g06 Is SSO available on the Starter plan?

vars.query: Is SSO available on the Starter plan?
vars.context:
[P-02] SAML SSO is available exclusively on Enterprise plans.
[P-03] The Pro plan adds audit logs and custom roles.

description: g07 What is the maximum file upload size?

vars.query: What is the maximum file upload size?
vars.context:
[L-09] Standard uploads support up to 25 MB per file.
[L-10] Enterprise workspaces can request a higher limit through support.

description: g08 What is the rate limit for /v2/search?

vars.query: What is the rate limit for /v2/search?
vars.context:
[API-19] /v2/search is limited to 120 requests per minute per token.
[API-20] Exceeding the limit returns HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header.

description: g09 Which Python version does the SDK require?

vars.query: Which Python version does the SDK require?
vars.context:
[SDK-04] The Python SDK requires Python 3.10 or newer.
[SDK-05] The Node.js SDK requires Node 18 or newer.

description: g10 Can I export audit logs through the API?

vars.query: Can I export audit logs through the API?
vars.context:
[A-11] Audit logs can be exported via GET /v2/audit-logs with an admin-scoped token.
[A-12] Audit logs are retained for 365 days on Enterprise and 90 days on Pro.

description: g11 How long is the free trial?

vars.query: How long is the free trial?
vars.context:
[P-01] New workspaces receive a 14-day free trial of Pro features.
[P-05] Plans: Starter $10/user/month, Pro $25/user/month, Enterprise by quote.

description: g12 How do I cancel my subscription?

vars.query: How do I cancel my subscription?
vars.context:
[B-01] Workspace owners can cancel at any time under Billing > Plan > Cancel.
[B-02] After cancelling, the workspace stays active until the end of the billing period.

description: g13 How do I enable two-factor authentication?

vars.query: How do I enable two-factor authentication?
vars.context:
[A-09] Enable TOTP 2FA under Account > Security.
[A-10] On Enterprise plans, admins can require 2FA for every member.

description: g14 Do you charge for inactive seats?

vars.query: Do you charge for inactive seats?
vars.context:
[B-14] All provisioned seats are billed monthly, regardless of login activity.
[B-15] Inviting beyond your seat limit triggers an immediate prorated charge.

description: g15 Can I move my workspace from the US to the EU region?

vars.query: Can I move my workspace from the US to the EU region?
vars.context:
[M-03] Cross-region migration requires a support ticket; self-serve migration is not available.
[H-02] Enterprise customers can choose the region at signup.

description: g16 Are webhook payloads signed?

vars.query: Are webhook payloads signed?
vars.context:
[W-04] Every webhook payload is signed with HMAC-SHA256 in the X-Signature header.
[W-06] Verify by computing HMAC-SHA256 over the raw request body with your signing secret.

description: g17 Do you support SCIM provisioning?

vars.query: Do you support SCIM provisioning?
vars.context:
[A-21] SCIM 2.0 user provisioning is included in Enterprise plans.
[P-02] SAML SSO is available exclusively on Enterprise plans.

description: g18 How long are deleted workspaces kept?

vars.query: How long are deleted workspaces kept?
vars.context:
[R-08] Soft-deleted workspaces are retained for 30 days before permanent purge.
[R-09] Purged workspaces cannot be recovered.

description: g19 Do you offer an on-premise version?

vars.query: Do you offer an on-premise version?
vars.context:
[H-01] The service runs in our cloud regions us-east-1 and eu-central-1.
[H-02] Enterprise customers can choose the region at signup.

description: g20 Is there a student discount?

vars.query: Is there a student discount?
vars.context:
[P-05] Plans: Starter $10/user/month, Pro $25/user/month, Enterprise by quote.
[P-01] New workspaces receive a 14-day free trial of Pro features.
